Saved provider is weak Store-owned; existing workers/preview generations continue their own cancellation/publication guards, with no new worker or mutable global.

No exact submillisecond or polling-wakeup latency parity is claimed.

Native deadline duration is captured before process spawning; its Instant deadline is constructed after successful spawn/pipe-reader setup, matching the finite subprocess wait contract rather than bounding OS exec/thread admission itself.

The native subprocess regressions use authored POSIX FIFO transports; the reference uses an authored delayed local executable. They exercise real Ffmpeg/HydrusFFMPEG paths, not codec correctness, external network or arbitrary process-tree cleanup.

Retained importer version, local-review metadata and duplicate PSD decode consumers have dedicated timeout boundaries. Import/folder/parser reader construction establishes other routing but does not mean each caller has a dedicated timeout integration regression.
Streaming frame reads retain fixed per-chunk policy and Drop kill/wait; no streaming/player reuse or broader media playback promotion. Non-Store tools keep their default policy.

The reference crop shows timeout 1 with ICC checked, while native cases intentionally preserve ICC false.

limitations: Only the three frozen original concrete image-cache controls are in scope for these assessments. Image-cache/image-prefetch/Speed-and-Memory structural parents, image-tile, video buffers and global backend parity remain Partial with zero extra credit; no aliases or structural completions. The separate prefetch-per-viewer percentage is reviewed independently and receives no credit from these three image-cache assessments.

Qt uses a controller-global ImageRendererCache. Native owns one cache per Main binding incarnation, shared by its real preview, still viewer, archive/delete and duplicate filter; standalone duplicate filters own separate policy-bound caches. Final Bound-clone drop, rebind and accepted close permanently retire admission while retained worker/callback handles cannot revive it.

Full still-image cache bytes are pending metadata RGB estimates and loaded RGB/RGBA raster bytes recounted at access. The cache admits one incoming item above its soft bound until maintenance, matching Qt. Pending decoders, accepted per-page 64MiB preview snapshots, current canvas/source/resize buffers, Slint image copies, playback and total process/GPU memory are separate presentation/resource ownership and are not evicted or counted as cache bytes.

Percentage uses strict estimated-size admission and applies only to future misses; existing admitted renderers remain subject to ordinary byte/idle maintenance. Saved policy and ICC changes refresh without resetting current accepted media, zoom, generation/page identity or viewing intervals. Future duplicate copies can only reuse cache-owned full rasters, while the current presentation remains independently retained.

Failed full-image and non-image thumbnail/poster fallback remain uncached; decoder injection keeps the public preview Decoder contract and bypasses the production cache. Existing worker bounds and late-publication generation guards are retained. Imported partial resolution falls back to100x100 exactly; real media metadata/ICC identity displaces stale cached sources.

Inline native duration fields preserve untouched raw299 seconds and enforce the actual300-second edit minimum; the Qt duration-popup geometry is a separate presentation difference. Monitor screen estimates use the owning physical monitor converted to logical size; headless windows without a monitor omit that caption rather than invent screen dimensions.
Validation is Linux only at this exact source and run; Windows and macOS are explicitly deferred, not passed.

The Qt PNGs have different staged values, accordion states and framework/font geometry from the final native states. This review confirms scoped readable controls, ordering and reference behavior; it does not claim pixel parity.

Exactly the six selected concrete controls receive review credit. Structural parents, general renderer/backend/tile/video/playback families and the separate duplicate-pair-count control retain broader Partial scope and zero extra credit.

All ten fresh native captures and both Qt PNGs were actually inspected. The unchanged strict finite/positive/bounds/positive-gap/long-warning geometry assertions passed. At 900px, long labels and the warning wrap readably; lower unselected controls remain scrollable rather than all-visible evidence.
The primary image shows saved cache=100B, timeout=5 minutes and storage=50%; its default previous=2, next=3, percentage=25% and pairs=3 are distinct from the saved prefetch producer.

updates.label: When there are too many tabs to fit, '...' elide their names so they fit:
updates.assessment: The page tab names checkbox stages/persists/imports/reopens with default true. The actual native tab label uses measured glyph widths and per-input fitting state to paint a middle ellipsis only when overflow requires it; the stored/decorated label and full tooltip remain unchanged. Disabled elision keeps complete label text in the scrolling strip; small overflow arrows preserve label height and reserve a trailing area so the final tab can be exposed at maximum scroll. Both horizontal and vertical bars consume the flag, including nested notebooks. The overflow probe uses the same selected600/unselected400 glyph weights as the painted tab, so a near-fit selected name triggers fitting rather than mistakenly scrolling.
